title: FairRARI: A Plug and Play Framework for Fairness-Aware PageRank
abstract: arXiv:2602.08589v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: PageRank (PR) is a fundamental algorithm in graph machine learning tasks. Owing to the increasing importance of algorithmic fairness, we consider the problem of computing PR vectors subject to various group-fairness criteria based on sensitive attributes of the vertices. At present, principled algorithms for this problem are lacking - some cannot guarantee that a target fairness level is achieved, while others do not feature optimality guarantees. In order to overcome these shortcomings, we put forth a unified in-processing convex optimization framework, termed FairRARI, for tackling different group-fairness criteria in a ``plug and play'' fashion. Leveraging a variational formulation of PR, the framework computes fair PR vectors by solving a strongly convex optimization problem with fairness constraints, thereby ensuring that a target fairness level is achieved. translated_title: FairRARI：一个即插即用的公平感知PageRank框架
translated_abstract: PageRank（PR）是图机器学习任务中的一种基础算法。随着算法公平性的重要性日益提升，我们研究了在基于顶点敏感属性的各种群体公平性准则约束下计算PR向量的问题。目前，针对该问题缺乏有原则性的算法——一些算法无法保证达到目标公平水平，而另一些算法则不具备最优性保证。为了克服这些缺点，我们提出了一个统一的处理中（in-processing）凸优化框架，称为FairRARI，能够以“即插即用”的方式处理不同的群体公平性准则。利用PageRank的变分形式，该框架通过求解带公平性约束的强凸优化问题来计算公平的PR向量，从而确保达到目标公平水平。我们进一步引入了三种不同的公平性准则，这些准则可以被有效地……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 提出FairRARI，一个即插即用的统一凸优化框架，通过求解带公平性约束的强凸优化问题来计算满足不同群体公平性准则的公平PageRank向量，同时保证达到目标公平水平并具备最优性保证。
